title_en: The King gives a gift to police officer injured in shooting
summary_en: His Majesty's Honour, the Governor of Narathiwat has been invited to present flowers and a basket of regalia to Dr. Yutthakar who was injured in an attack on police investigation unit and is being treated as a patient at his Royal Palace
